name: openshape3d
description: Ask Claude to design 3D-printable parts in OpenShape 3D on this Mac, then save them as STL files for your printer.
long_description:
Describe what you want — a flowerpot, a box for your electronics, a bracket — and Claude models it in OpenShape 3D while you watch, checks it is a solid that will print, and saves an STL to your Downloads folder.

In OpenShape 3D, open Settings ▸ AI Assistant, switch it on, and copy the pairing code into this extension. Everything stays on your Mac: the extension only talks to the OpenShape 3D app running on this computer.

pairing_code.title: Pairing code
pairing_code.description: In OpenShape 3D: Settings ▸ AI Assistant ▸ Copy Pairing Code. Paste it here.

tools.name: os3d
tools.description: Model in OpenShape 3D: read the design (bodies, faces, edges, a picture), sketch, extrude, revolve, shell, fillet, boolean, set materials, check the solid and save STL files to Downloads
